decisions.reason: The polymer concrete housing has a page of its own and fits the firm's core drainage families, so early results give no shortfall that would prompt search for other uses of the resources.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's stated direction, and an established mid-sized specialist has enough slack to carry the line while its results are still uncertain.
As the flagship designer product with its own page, it embodies the firm's aspiration of design quality and is very unlikely to be dropped after one year.
The shower element with integrated slope supports the low-profile, integrated system strategy, and the limited website presence is not yet evidence of results below aspiration.
The backflow-protected basement drain was actively promoted as a newly developed solution to a clear safety need, which suggests satisfactory early performance.

The air-admittance valve is a peripheral but complementary product that is only mentioned on the website, so it carries somewhat higher risk, but nothing points to a clear shortfall that would justify dropping it now.
